lean.name: UpperTheory.V.FW.sinnott
lean.note: Sinnott’s step works modulo a sufficiently high power of $\ell$. If the difference of a function and its translate is supported on a fixed interval, and the sum of the function’s rescalings by the specified $\ell$-adic units vanishes, the coefficients on that interval all vanish under the stated independence condition.
